title: Transamerica to pay $110m in life insurance settlement as judge cuts lawyers’ fees to $27.5m
summary_full: In a pivotal ruling, a federal judge in California has sanctioned a $110 million settlement with Transamerica Life Insurance Company, favoring policyowners. The judge notably slashed attorneys' fees from $47.5 million to $27.5 million. Plaintiffs William F. Wren and John Murphy alleged the insurer did not honor its commitment for cash value increases. Following extensive legal battles, funds will be automatically allocated to eligible policyowners, simplifying the payout process.
